decisions.reason: The MS 284 start and end dates are independent of the session weekdays and time slots and are already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The MS 284 allocated budget is independent of the session schedule and is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The session schedule does not change the signature requirement or placement; the candidate's existing same-message MODIFY already captures the MS 284 scope extension.
